title: microRNA profiles of meningiomas

publications.title: Downregulated microRNA-200a in meningiomas promotes tumor growth by reducing E-cadherin and activating the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway.

institution: Department of Neurology, Massachusetts General Hospital / Brigham and Women's Hospital, Harvard Medical School
platform: Wurdinger/Krichevsky miRNA spotted array IV (GPL7436), non-coding RNA profiling by array

normal_control_tissue.type: arachnoidal tissue (non-neoplastic control specimens, same profiling platform)

processed_data_format: GSM-level quantile-normalized data table (combining technical replicates per Series_overall_design)
needs_manual_review_reason: Live GEO verification (2026-07-11) confirms 34 total deposited GSM records (Series_type = 'Non-coding RNA profiling by array', not literally 'Expression profiling by array'), matching the discovery-log's '14 meningioma + 3 arachnoidal control (34 samples with replicates)': Series_overall_design explicitly states '14 meningioma tumor samples were compared to 3 arachnoidal tissue control samples. Two technical replicates were performed for each sample.' sample_count (34) reflects the literal number of deposited GSM records/array hybridizations; patient_count (14) reflects unique meningioma patients only, with the 3 arachnoidal controls tracked separately in normal_control_tissue (each control likely also has 2 replicate arrays, not independently confirmed). Modality is recorded as 'mirna_seq' per this project's controlled vocabulary, which as of this verification date has a single value covering both array-based and sequencing-based miRNA profiling; the actual platform here (GPL7436, Wurdinger/Krichevsky spotted miRNA array) is array-based, not literally sequencing, this is stated explicitly in the platform field for clarity. Publication (PMID 19703993, Saydam et al., Mol Cell Biol 2009, the miR-200a tumor-suppressor study) confirmed via PubMed esummary, matches the series summary text closely. Grade, sex, age, location, and outcome fields were not present in the series-level summary/design and individual GSM records were not exhaustively checked in this pass; raw_data_available left 'Not reported' since no CEL/raw supplementary file was found at the series level (only a processed quantile-normalized data table appears to be deposited). large_cohort not computed for mirna_seq per current changelog (fewer than 4 records in modality).
